what: Over the panel the system cursor is hidden, and when it is over a labeled picture a 4px dot takes the cursor spot with the name (like a product name) directly below it, centered, following with no delay. Leaving the picture makes the dot and name disappear

options.[data-fx-part=item]: Child to show the name on — the name is that child’s data-label
options.text: Name used when data-label is absent, default VIEW MORE
options.--fx-size: Name font size (via style), default max(14px, 1.42vw)
options.--fx-color: Dot and name color (via style), default --kf-ink

note: On touch devices (no hover), the cursor is not hidden and nothing is attached. The dot is position: fixed, so do not put it inside an ancestor that has a transform (attach it to body).

from.where: index.html Hero slider (original .p-mouseStalker — product name data-product)
